textTemplates.name: ChatterPost
textTemplates.text:
@{!formula_OppOwnerName}

@{!$Record.Owner.RVP__c}


A new prospect from {!formula_AccountName} has just signed up for Tanium Evaluation (14-day trial of Tanium). This prospect has now been given access to their evaluation and we are building their evaluation instance now. 


This evaluation can be used to truly accelerate this sales opportunity over the next 14 days. 


To that end, we ask that you do the following:

Please reach out and introduce yourself to the prospect & welcome them to the evaluation (please coordinate this outreach with your SDR)

Please set a meeting with the prospect in a few days (4-5 days) to check-in on how the evaluation is going

Please include the Partner who referred the customer to the evaluation (if applicable) in all outreach. 

The prospect’s partner preference can be found in the Partner Referral field on the Contact record. 


Please reach out to trial@tanium.com or @[Samrudh Rajachudamani] with any questions.

textTemplates.name: textTemplate_BookingChatterPostBody
textTemplates.text:
Based on the current Close Date of your opportunity, you may be trying to change the stage and/or close date of an opportunity that is outside of the allowed timing per Tanium’s bookings policy.


Orders that include software quote line types of "New Customer", "Upsell" or "Add-on" must have subscription start dates within 7 calendar days from the end of the booking month (in order to book in the same month). For example, if the opportunity Close Date is in March, the "New Customer", "Upsell" or "Add-on" software items must have a Start Date of April 7th or earlier to qualify as a March booking.


You may need to adjust the Close Date of your opportunity or generate a new Primary Quote with an earlier Start Date. To confirm you are within the bookings policy, please reach out to your regional Deal Desk or Quoting Operations contact.
